steps.say: Dusk on the Penance Road. The prison wagon lies on its side. Whatever stopped it has moved on.
Oi. OI! You there. Still breathing? Good. That makes two of us.
The guards are dead and I'm still locked in this cage. The one who ran east down the road had the key on his belt.
Find him. Find the key. Then come back and let me out, and I'll owe you my life. Not worth much, but it's yours.

toast: Weapons lie by the dead guards. Stand over one and press E to take it.
